title: Review of unstaged app/system URL cleanup
tagline: Consolidate scattered URL building into one place ＝ prepares the domain migration so links and logins never break
overview:
- Consolidate scattered URL building and host checks into resolveAppUrl / isLegacyHost ＝ URLs are built in one place, so missed updates can no longer cause broken links
- Route both deployment modes (subdomain / legacy-path) through the same code path ＝ customers on the new domain and the old domain now behave identically
- Replace relative links in shared UI, dashboard, and settings with absolute URLs ＝ every page lands on the correct domain no matter where you navigate from
- Update the architecture docs and migration plan to the current separation of concerns ＝ anyone reading the migration guide sees docs that match reality

groups.title: Shared URL / host-check foundation
groups.intent: Consolidate per-deployment-mode URL building and host checks into one place, so legacy-path and subdomain modes can be switched safely.
groups.impact: Foundation code also used on the legacy path, so the blast radius is wide.

sections.title: New shared entry point resolveAppUrl
sections.explain: URL building that used to be scattered across call sites is consolidated into resolveAppUrl in url-config.ts. It is a two-way branch: https://{service}.{APEX_DOMAIN} when userUrlMode is 'subdomain', otherwise {SITE_ROOT}/{service}. This is the core change for the plan's "consolidate URL building" item.

annotations.text: What values `service` can take ('app' | 'system' only?) is not stated in the plan and cannot be inferred from the type.

sections.title: Stricter isLegacyHost check
sections.explain: A separate change in the same url-config.ts. The host check moves from substring matching (includes) to exact equality (===). This reads as a guard against spoofed hosts like legacy.example.com.evil.com after the subdomain migration, but as a side effect it also changes how hosts with port numbers are treated.

annotations.text: Exact matching now rejects hosts with a port number such as localhost:3000. Whether this is intentional cannot be determined from the plan.

sections.title: Test updates
sections.explain: The auth tests are rewritten to assume the new resolveAppUrl. The vi.mock module replacement is gone — the tests now call the real resolveAppUrl, so they exercise the actual branching logic.

annotations.text: Moves from vitest's global injection to explicit imports.

groups.title: Absolute URLs for app/system links
groups.intent: Replaces relative paths in shared UI, dashboard, settings, and sponsors with app apex URLs.

sections.title: Bulk replacement of navigation links
sections.explain: The same-shaped change — relative href paths replaced with resolveAppUrl-based absolute URLs — appears across 96 hunks. All are mechanical replacements; only one representative hunk from Nav is shown here.

groups.title: Architecture docs and migration plan updates
groups.intent: Updates the architecture doc and migration plan to the current separation of concerns.

sections.title: Rewritten URL design section
sections.explain: The URL design section of architecture.md is updated from the relative-path assumption to the resolveAppUrl approach.
